narrative_summary: In a stressed market, conservative investors flee to safety (gold, cash), while retail investors engage in panic selling and fund outflows. Hedge funds and leveraged traders de-lever but also make opportunistic momentum bets, leading to a significant reallocation of capital from risky assets to safe havens and short-term fixed income.
key_mechanisms: Flight to safety by conservative investors
Panic selling and herd behavior by retail investors
De-leveraging and opportunistic bets by hedge funds/leveraged traders
Duration management (flight to short maturities) by fixed-income managers
